EXPLORER.name: Explorer
EXPLORER.tagline: Goes first. Moves the edge of the map.
EXPLORER.description: The Wayfinders went ahead and decided where the road would go. New roads, new ground and places nobody pointed you at pay best. A road you have not taken is only a rumour.

WIZARD.name: Wizard
WIZARD.tagline: Cuts the runes again. Looks twice.
WIZARD.description: The Cutters kept the runes legible, which mostly meant cutting them again. Old stones, odd markers and shapes drawn with your own track pay best. There is more to a place than the map admits.

WARRIOR.name: Warrior
WARRIOR.tagline: Keeps the road with the legs. Pays the hill.
WARRIOR.description: The Menders carried the stone. Distance, height and long hours out pay best, measured against yourself and nobody else. The hill charges everyone the same.

SCRIBE.name: Scribe
SCRIBE.description: The Clerks kept the toll-book and everything else. Notes, photographs and places looked at properly pay best. A thing in the book is harder to forget.
SCRIBE.saying: It may as well be you.
